x: At West London Stadium on November 7th Richard O'Hara, Francis Ward and Leo Lyons all ran p.b.'s in the 3000m. Richard finished 2nd in 9.00.1, Francis 3rd in 9.02.4 and Leo 8th in 9.09.1.

In the 'B' team Francis Ward, who has returned from 2 years in the U.S.A. proved fastest with Andy Moore close behind. Our 'D' team comprised young members having an average age of 13 years and their general high level of performance promises well for the future.

Without wishing to pre-empt our next Edition's full report - Oliver Foote won, John Gladwin was second, Mark Sinclair 6th, and Dave North 7th to give an all time record score of 16 points. Read also next time of super runs from Andy North and Francis Ward.

Francis Ward, back in Ireland for a 6 month University training course, used the opportunity to get in some high quality races. On March 24th at Straffan in a 10k Road Race he finished 12th out of a field of 500 in a creditable 32.49.
Oliver Foote was on schedule to lead the individual championship but was on holiday for the last match. Notable improvements from Andy North, Martin Lake and Francis Ward.

Although the 5½ mile course was wet the stoney paths helped the faster track men to a good start and after 2 miles the 250 strong field was led by 4 Belgravians - Oliver Foote, Mark Sinclair, John Gladwin and Dave North, with Andy North and Francis Ward not far behind.
